subject: dbc_contracts
summary: Reservation.ocl elevates W3 unauthorized failure to checkable properties: reserve adds UnauthorizedErrorOnReserve (oclIsInvalid), NoHoldCreatedOnUnauthorizedReserve, and AvailableStockUnchangedOnUnauthorizedReserve; new Reservation::release has PrincipalAuthorized plus UnauthorizedErrorOnRelease / HoldsUnchangedOnUnauthorizedRelease / AvailableStockUnchangedOnUnauthorizedRelease. W1 happy-path and W2 insufficient-stock posts retained. Authorized restore deferred to W4 as planned. Not vacuous at standard density.

findings.detail: lint: ambiguous phrase 'sufficient' in Brief scope text
lint: overlapping touches across W3–W5 on shared OCL/OpenAPI/src; solidsdd-run must serialize these items

UnauthorizedErrorOnRelease and HoldsUnchangedOnUnauthorizedRelease overlap on holds() equality; Void result cannot use oclIsInvalid like reserve. Acceptable at standard density—derived tests must still assert named UnauthorizedError throw, not only state equality.
HoldExists / AvailableStockRestored for authorized release remain W4 hooks; release context currently owns authZ failure only—intentional slice isolation.
